assistant.answer: Customers can return unused items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be in original condition with packaging and proof of purchase. Source: Simulated returns policy, dated September 2026.
顾客可以在收货后30天内退回未使用的商品。商品必须保持原状，并保留包装和购买凭证。（来源：Simulated returns policy, dated September 2026）

Los clientes pueden devolver artículos sin usar dentro de los 30 días posteriores a la entrega. El producto debe estar en su estado original, con embalaje y comprobante de compra. Fuente: Simulated returns policy, dated September 2026.
Approved refunds are usually processed within 5 to 10 business days after the returned item is received and inspected. Source: Simulated refund policy, dated September 2026.
退回商品被收到并检查通过后，批准的退款通常会在5到10个工作日内处理。（来源：Simulated refund policy, dated September 2026）
Los reembolsos aprobados normalmente se procesan dentro de 5 a 10 días hábiles después de recibir e inspeccionar el artículo devuelto. Fuente: Simulated refund policy, dated September 2026.
Standard international shipping usually takes 7 to 14 business days. Delivery time may vary by destination country and customs clearance. Source: Simulated shipping policy, dated September 2026.
标准国际物流通常需要7到14个工作日。具体时间可能会因目的地国家和海关清关而变化。（来源：Simulated shipping policy, dated September 2026）

El envío internacional estándar normalmente tarda de 7 a 14 días hábiles. El tiempo puede variar según el país de destino y el despacho de aduanas. Fuente: Simulated shipping policy, dated September 2026.

If tracking has not updated for more than 7 days or the parcel is marked delivered but not received, contact support with your order number and tracking number. Source: Simulated shipping support policy, dated September 2026.
如果物流超过7天没有更新，或者显示已送达但你没有收到，请联系客户支持并提供订单号和物流单号。（来源：Simulated shipping support policy, dated September 2026）

Si el seguimiento no se actualiza durante más de 7 días, o el paquete aparece como entregado pero no lo recibiste, contacta con soporte e indica tu número de pedido y número de seguimiento. Fuente: Simulated shipping support policy, dated September 2026.
Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Once an order has shipped, customers should follow the return process after delivery. Source: Simulated order policy, dated September 2026.
订单发货前可以取消。订单一旦发货，顾客需要在收货后按照退货流程处理。（来源：Simulated order policy, dated September 2026）

Los pedidos pueden cancelarse antes del envío. Si el pedido ya fue enviado, el cliente debe seguir el proceso de devolución después de la entrega. Fuente: Simulated order policy, dated September 2026.

Customers are responsible for customs duties, import taxes and local charges required by the destination country unless the checkout page states otherwise. Source: Simulated customs policy, dated September 2026.
除非结账页面另有说明，目的地国家要求的关税、进口税和本地费用由顾客承担。（来源：Simulated customs policy, dated September 2026）

El cliente es responsable de los aranceles, impuestos de importación y cargos locales exigidos por el país de destino, salvo que la página de pago indique lo contrario. Fuente: Simulated customs policy, dated September 2026.
The store accepts major credit cards, debit cards and supported digital wallets shown at checkout. Source: Simulated payment policy, dated September 2026.
商店接受主要信用卡、借记卡，以及结账页面显示的受支持电子钱包。（来源：Simulated payment policy, dated September 2026）
La tienda acepta las principales tarjetas de crédito, tarjetas de débito y billeteras digitales compatibles que aparecen en la página de pago. Fuente: Simulated payment policy, dated September 2026.

Eligible electronics include a 12-month limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Damage caused by misuse, accidents or normal wear is not covered. Source: Simulated warranty policy, dated September 2026.
符合条件的电子产品包含12个月有限保修，覆盖制造缺陷。误用、意外损坏或正常磨损不在保修范围内。（来源：Simulated warranty policy, dated September 2026）

Los productos electrónicos elegibles incluyen una garantía limitada de 12 meses que cubre defectos de fabricación. No cubre daños por mal uso, accidentes o desgaste normal. Fuente: Simulated warranty policy, dated September 2026.
Customers may request an address change only before the order is shipped. After shipping, the carrier may not allow address changes. Source: Simulated order policy, dated September 2026.
顾客只能在订单发货前申请修改收货地址。发货后，承运商可能不允许修改地址。（来源：Simulated order policy, dated September 2026）
Coupon codes may fail if they are expired, entered incorrectly, limited to specific products, or not combinable with another promotion. Source: Simulated promotion policy, dated September 2026.
优惠码可能因为已过期、输入错误、仅限指定商品，或不能与其他促销同时使用而无法生效。（来源：Simulated promotion policy, dated September 2026）
Size exchanges are handled as a return and new purchase. The returned item must be unused and meet the 30-day return window. Source: Simulated exchange policy, dated September 2026.
Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 Singapore time, excluding public holidays. Source: Simulated support policy, dated September 2026.
Report damaged items within 48 hours of delivery and include your order number, photos of the item, and photos of the packaging. Source: Simulated damaged item policy, dated September 2026.
请在收货后48小时内报告商品损坏，并提供订单号、商品照片和包装照片。（来源：Simulated damaged item policy, dated September 2026）

If you received the wrong item, contact support with your order number and a photo of the item received. Support will arrange a replacement or return label after review. Source: Simulated order issue policy, dated September 2026.

Si recibiste el artículo equivocado, contacta con soporte con tu número de pedido y una foto del producto recibido. Soporte organizará un reemplazo o una etiqueta de devolución después de revisar el caso. Fuente: Simulated order issue policy, dated September 2026.
Some orders are split into separate shipments. Check the order page for multiple tracking numbers before reporting a missing item. Source: Simulated shipping policy, dated September 2026.
部分订单可能会分开发货。请先在订单页面查看是否有多个物流单号，再报告缺少商品。（来源：Simulated shipping policy, dated September 2026）

Pre-order items ship after the release date shown on the product page. If an order includes regular and pre-order items, they may ship separately. Source: Simulated pre-order policy, dated September 2026.

Los productos de preventa se envían después de la fecha de lanzamiento indicada en la página del producto. Si el pedido incluye artículos normales y de preventa, pueden enviarse por separado. Fuente: Simulated pre-order policy, dated September 2026.

Use the password reset link and check that the email address matches your order account. If login still fails, contact support with the account email. Source: Simulated account policy, dated September 2026.
请先使用密码重置链接，并确认邮箱地址与下单账号一致。如果仍然无法登录，请用账号邮箱联系客户支持。（来源：Simulated account policy, dated September 2026）
Invoices can be downloaded from the order history page after payment is completed. Business customers may add billing details before checkout. Source: Simulated invoice policy, dated September 2026.

Las facturas se pueden descargar desde el historial de pedidos después de completar el pago. Los clientes empresariales pueden añadir datos de facturación antes de pagar. Fuente: Simulated invoice policy, dated September 2026.
Gift cards can be used with one eligible coupon unless the checkout page states that the promotion cannot be combined. Source: Simulated promotion policy, dated September 2026.
礼品卡可以和一个符合条件的优惠码一起使用，除非结账页面说明该促销不能叠加。（来源：Simulated promotion policy, dated September 2026）

Customers may request account data deletion through support. Order records required for tax, fraud prevention or legal duties may be retained for the required period. Source: Simulated privacy policy, dated September 2026.

Payments may fail because of incorrect card details, bank rejection, insufficient funds, expired cards or unsupported billing countries. No order is created until payment succeeds. Source: Simulated payment support policy, dated September 2026.

Products sold by the store are sourced from approved suppliers. If authenticity documents are available for a category, they appear on the product page or can be requested from support. Source: Simulated product policy, dated September 2026.
